label: Full J1 upgrades necessary-source paths to all-source paths (inference)
rule: Actual guarded support paths, explicit source scope and existing transitive-closure well-foundedness
meaning: For each off-world existing concrete source of a necessary concrete target, full J1 makes that SAME source necessary, so the necessary-source path property applies. This maps the two path scopes under an explicit additional assumption; it does not supply J1 or a source witness.
